dedupe_keys.name: dvb specifications and bluebooks digital video broadcasting

description: The DVB specifications page is the index of the DVB Project's technical standards for digital television. Contents: a searchable list of specifications published as BlueBooks and later standardised in a European statutory body, each with a short name, information page and a link to the latest version; verification and validation tools and test materials; publication types shared between DVB and ETSI; and a section of deprecated specifications. Producer: the DVB Project, whose specifications for terrestrial, satellite and cable delivery are in use worldwide; those published by ETSI can also be downloaded from ETSI. Coverage: global, technical. Access: a public form to find and download documents, with no registration seen on the page read. Licence and cost: free to download according to the page wording; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: the entries are standards, not measurements of networks, and the list of individual specifications was not enumerated for this record. Simulation uses: the modulation, coding and transport definitions feed broadcast link-budget, coverage and capacity models, and the test material supports validating them. Related record: the DVB-T2 specification entry (data-dvb-t2-specification-etsi) covers one member of this family.
